sources.title: CNMI Public Law 13-29 (Commonwealth Film, Video and Media Office), CNMI Law Revision Commission
sources.said: (6) To prepare an explanatory guide showing the impact of relevant Commonwealth and municipal tax statutes, regulations and administrative opinions on typical production activities; … Section 6. Regulations - Permit Fees. All film/media permit fees in the Commonwealth will be collected by the film office under a one-stop, single permit framework. All film/media permit fees collected by the film office will be solely used to fund the operations of the film office. … The following one-time project fees shall be established: nonprofit, public service announcements, student projects and projects conducted by CNMI residents and/or businesses for local customers are exempt; $300.00 for still photography and other "graphics" projects; $500.00 for all other projects such as, but not limited to, pre-production, production and/or post-production of motion pictures, films, television commercials, videos, music recordings, etc.

figures.finding: producer-MP.json: no CNMI film incentive or fund found (its blocker); a series would be under the same. PL 13-29, read whole (1,529 words), sets a film office and a one-stop permit with fees and no rebate or credit; whether a later act added one was not checked.
